result.question: Compare Apple's services revenue growth rate to its products revenue growth rate over the last two fiscal years.
result.answer: Based on the available evidence, the most recent two fiscal years for which full-year Products and Services revenue breakdowns are provided are FY2024 and FY2023. Apple's Products revenue was $294,866 million in FY2024 and $298,085 million in FY2023 [0000320193-24-000120:ex-99-press-release-p002]. Apple's Services revenue was $96,169 million in FY2024 and $85,200 million in FY2023 [0000320193-24-000120:ex-99-press-release-p002]. Calculated from these reported figures, Services revenue grew approximately 12.9% year-over-year (from $85,200 million to $96,169 million), while Products revenue declined approximately 1.1% year-over-year (from $298,085 million to $294,866 million) [0000320193-24-000120:ex-99-press-release-p002]. Thus, Services revenue grew while Products revenue contracted over the same period, meaning Services revenue growth substantially exceeded Products revenue growth in FY2024 compared to FY2023 [0000320193-24-000120:ex-99-press-release-p002]. The provided excerpts do not include a full-year Products and Services revenue breakdown for FY2025, though total net sales of $416,161 million were reported for FY2025 [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2025-09-27].
